citations.label: KDnuggets (I. Palomares), The State of Agent Engineering Report Overview (on LangChain's 2026 survey, n=1340)
citations.excerpt: 89% of respondents from all backgrounds have implemented an observability mechanism, although only 52.4% are conducting offline evaluations. 32% of whom mention quality as their top barrier to adoption and deployment.

citations.label: Digital Applied, Agentic AI Adoption: 250-Agency Survey 2026 Results (n=250)
citations.excerpt: Evaluation and testing is the #1 blocker, named by 49% of agencies as a top-3 obstacle. The bottom-quartile agencies reporting 0.7x ROI almost always lack a workflow-level evaluation harness.
